lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cu3Ni3Se4 (reduced formula CuNiSe4/3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group P2_12_12_1 (No. 1), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with four Se neighbors and Ni centers with five Se neighbors, while Se centers adopt five- or six-coordinate environments with mixed Cu/Ni neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is two-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cu and Ni polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Se-centered polyhedra.
